name: Pixel Transition

duration.description: Total tile duration in ms. Below 160ms switches instantly. Capped at 1200ms.

a11y: Retains semantic host content and its focus outline.
Decorative layers are hidden from assistive technology.
Motion settles within five seconds, or offers an explicit pause control.
Responds to reduced motion at mount and on preference changes.
Requires two direct children with data-pixel-face. Inactive faces stay in layout with aria-hidden and inert; no hidden-attribute CSS override.
